item.title: Experienced Fijiana XV front row named for Hong Kong clash
item.description: The Vodafone Fijiana XV has named an experienced front row to marshal the team in their WXV Global Series Challenger match against Hong Kong. Karalaini Naisewa will start at prop alongside hooker Bitila Tawake and fellow prop Tiana Robanakadavu in the front row.
item.content:encoded:
The Vodafone Fijiana XV has named an experienced front row to marshal the team in their WXV Global Series Challenger match against Hong Kong.

Karalaini Naisewa will start at prop alongside hooker Bitila Tawake and fellow prop Tiana Robanakadavu in the front row.

Locks Karavaki Lutumaibau and Carletta Yee complete the tight five.

Alfreda Fisher and Merewairita Neivosa will start at flanker, while Manuqalo Komaitai is at number eight.

Evivi Senikarivi is at halfback, while Varanisese Qoro starts at fly-half.

In the backline, Repeka Tove starts on the openside wing, while inside centre Ruth Raketekete partners Adi Salote Nailolo in the midfield.

Atelaite Ralivanawa starts on the blindside wing, while Litiana Vueti is at fullback.

The Fijiana will also have Selai Naliva, Zipporah Sorokacika, Adi Keri Lawavou, Nunia Daunimoala, Sereana Maragi, Kolora Lomani, Vika Nakacia and Vasemaca Duva available as impact players.

item.title: Fiji Kulas fall 4-0 to PNG in MSG Prime Minister’s Cup opener
item.description: The Fiji Kulas have suffered a tough start to their MSG Prime Minister’s Cup 2026 campaign after going down 4-0 to Papua New Guinea at the HFC Bank Stadium in Suva. PNG took control of the match early, with Keren Kalapai completing a first-half hat-trick.
item.content:encoded:
The Fiji Kulas have suffered a tough start to their MSG Prime Minister’s Cup 2026 campaign after going down 4-0 to Papua New Guinea at the HFC Bank Stadium in Suva.

PNG took control of the match early, with Keren Kalapai completing a first-half hat-trick.

The Kulas went into the half-time break trailing 3-0 and their hopes of mounting a comeback were dealt another blow just a minute after the restart when Calista Maneo scored PNG’s fourth goal.

Fiji was unable to find a way back into the contest as PNG held firm to secure a convincing victory on the opening day of the women’s competition.

Kulas will face Vanuatu at 7pm on Sunday .

Meanwhile, Bula Boys will play the Solomon Islands at 7 tonight.

item.title: Crest Fiji Pearls suffer second loss to Tonga
item.description: The Crest Fiji Pearls lost their second game against Tonga, going down 72–60 in the Oceania Regional Qualifiers in Tonga for the 2027 Netball World Cup. The Fijian community in the Tonga turned out in numbers to cheer for the team.
item.content:encoded:
The Crest Fiji Pearls lost their second game against Tonga, going down 72–60 in the Oceania Regional Qualifiers in Tonga for the 2027 Netball World Cup.

The Fijian community in the Tonga turned out in numbers to cheer for the team.
